verdict.rationale: Omnara documents agents you can launch programmatically through the CLI, REST API, or SDK. They keep working across crashes and machine disconnects, you can queue their next task, and you choose which actions need approval, so they can run autonomously in the background. The evidence covers one-off launches and task queuing, not recurring automations: no schedules, cron, or event triggers that start agents on their own. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring runs, event-triggered automation setup, independent hands-on confirmation of unattended background operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Launch your first agent with Omnara via the dashboard, or programmatically with the CLI, the REST API, or the TypeScript SDK.
Agents keep their conversation history across crashes, restarts, and machine disconnects, so work can resume without starting a new conversation.
Follow an agent’s progress live, send a correction while it’s working, or queue up its next task.
You can decide which actions need approval, and agents can pause to ask questions when they need your input.
